product_metadata.title: Towle Living 3-Piece Ceramic Caddy with Wood Tray
features: STYLISH ORGANIZATION: this 3-Piece Ceramic Caddy with Wooden Tray will keep your flatware neatly organized and all in one place
HIGH QUALITY MATERIALS: made From Ceramic, each caddy features a stainless steel impression of a fork, knife or spoon
EASY TO TRANSPORT: included wooden tray makes this set easy to carry to your table or buffet
COMPACT DESIGN: each caddy measures 4-1 4 inch high; the wood tray is 13-1 2 inch long x 5 inch wide
EASY TO CLEAN: flatware caddies are dishwasher safe; the wood tray should be hand washed with a damp cloth and dried immediately
description: This 3 Piece Ceramic Caddy on Wood Tray will keep your flatware neatly organized and all in one place. White ceramic caddies feature stainless steel impressions/designations for forks, knives and spoons (one on each caddy). The caddies sit on a finely finished brown wooden tray for easy transport to the table or buffet. Caddies are 4-1/4 inch high, wood tray is 13-1/2 inch long x 5 inch wide.
